name: effort-router
description: Sets a turn's reasoning effort from an inline !low / !medium / !high / !xhigh / !max token or from keyword rules, and strips the token from the prompt

rules.title: Keyword rules
rules.description: Prompts starting with a phrase run at a level, one rule per entry as "phrase => level" (e.g. "quick => low"). An inline !level token wins over a rule.
